featured.takeaway: A multi-agent system chooses which DFT calculations to run next, so catalyst models trained on OC20 extend to the multi-adsorbate and solvation regimes the dataset leaves out.
featured.whyFeatured: Specific, quantified gap (OC20 covers ~0.07% of configurations) with a concrete mechanism to close it; testable.

featured.takeaway: Epidemic ODE constraints become features an LLM agent can search over, so infectious-disease trial-outcome models predict from mechanistic quantities such as trial-specific reproduction numbers.
featured.whyFeatured: The least obvious bridge in the set: compartmental-model physics inside an LLM agent's feature search.

featured.takeaway: A mesh-based graph simulator, as used for physics, is trained on epidemic dynamics so it generalises across infection seeds, population densities and interventions and supports real-time counterfactual policy runs.
featured.whyFeatured: Transfers a property GNS is known for (generalising across initial conditions) to epidemics; draws on three papers.

featured.takeaway: A CLIP-style model pretrained on paired satellite imagery and text estimates crop yield zero-shot, prompted with natural-language descriptions of crop conditions.
featured.whyFeatured: Clear, testable zero-shot claim that would remove the labelled-yield bottleneck if it holds.

featured.takeaway: CGCNN serves as a fast surrogate inside an agentic discovery loop, so candidate crystal structures are proposed, scored and refined in silico before any DFT calculation.
featured.whyFeatured: Concrete loop design with a named surrogate; drawn from three papers across materials science and agentic AI.

featured.takeaway: Self-RAG critique tokens go inside every PharmAgents agent, so each stage retrieves on demand and passes token-level quality signals downstream. The validator flags the claim about beating PharmAgents' 37.94% success rate as risky.
featured.whyFeatured: Shows the audit working: a confident numeric claim beyond the evidence is flagged RISKY (0.72).
